requirement: Creating a site from an existing workspace keeps the ready screen until the new workspace is opened

oracle.invariant: The add-site wizard started from an existing site stays on that site after the new site's agent is ready. The Open the workspace button remains visible and clicking it navigates to the new site's workspace. The /new/ flow keeps its existing automatic navigation behavior.
